pylons_vi: 3 trụ tháp chữ V (extradosed): hai cột trên bệ móng, phía trên mặt cầu thành hai lưỡi nghiêng ra ngoài ≈25°, dây văng đỏ
pylons_en: 3 V-shaped pylon piers (extradosed): two columns on a pile cap, continuing above the deck as blades leaning out ≈25°, red stays

model3d.notes: Extradosed 90+2×160+90 m, 21.5 m concrete box (CONINCO, Hải Phòng portal). Three 'V – Victory' pylon piers. Round 5 (2026-11-27, research/model-review/brief-round5-ben-rung.md): foundation added (pile cap ≈20 × 32 × 5 m at the waterline, two near-vertical columns under the deck edges with a tie beam and an under-deck crossbeam); blades lean ≈25° outward (VnExpress / Tuổi Trẻ: tower inclined ≈65° from horizontal); deck ≈22 m above water at the pylons, blade sizes, 12 stays per side per blade and the semi-fan pattern estimated from the Tuổi Trẻ / VTC / VnExpress photos (7/2024). Pylon height above deck ≈18 m (estimated).

pylon_custom.description: Bến Rừng 'V – Victory' pier: two near-vertical columns stand on a large pile cap at the waterline, joined by a tie beam at mid-height and a crossbeam under the girder. Above the deck each column continues as a flat blade leaning outward about 25°, white with a red inner face, carrying a short fan of red extradosed stays to its deck edge.

notes: Confirmed by the VTC aerial. Round 5: foundation and V proportions corrected from photos.
colour: white blades with red inner face; red stays
review: No geometry change; red stays and white/red blades confirmed
